{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N5","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: M.S. # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2 # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.21 kg"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"TOLERANCE NOTE :- (English) 1) ALL H7 HOLES C.D SHOULD BE CONTROLLED WITHIN +/- 0.02. / IT7 2) ALL HOLES,TAP & COUNTER BORE C.D, SHOULD BE CONTROLLED WITHIN +/- 0.1"}],"comment":"Note N5 specifies an I.Z.B.P. (trivalent zinc) plating finish while note N1 calls out H7 holes, but no allowance is made for the plating thickness on these tight-tolerance holes. Plating buildup will reduce hole diameters and cause mating pins or fasteners to fail to assemble; the designer must either increase the pre-plate hole size by the expected coating thickness or specify masking of the H7 holes before plating."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add a note specifying that H7 hole dimensions are after plating, or add plating thickness allowance to the hole sizes, or require masking of H7 holes prior to plating."}]}
